lines.text: Moses tells Israel that the LORD their God will cross the Jordan ahead of them as a consuming fire.
Moses stayed on Horeb forty days and forty nights, and the LORD gave him two stone tablets inscribed by God's finger.
Moses came down the blazing mountain, saw the molten calf, and shattered the two tablets before the people's eyes.
Moses burned the calf and ground it to dust, and Israel rebelled when sent out from Kadesh-barnea.
Moses made an ark of acacia wood and placed the new tablets in it after the LORD wrote the Ten Commandments.
